summary: Seek authored pull-request ownership and skip unchanged GitHub-watch maintenance

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection fold change. The lookup retains URL-or-repository/number matching, canonical order, optional head filtering and run deduplication. GitHub-watch maintenance now retains its recorded declaration/watch/seat reads and next deadline between evaluations, with a 60-second safety pass. New or changed dependencies, local fresh-context requests, repairs and due work reselect it. A clean stage does not publish fault recovery; actual successful evaluation still does.

schema.detail: Adds two partial expression indexes over retained resource.observed claims for resource/mission-run/*/pull-request, keyed by URL and repository/number. Existing databases build these additive indexes on first open. Numeric schema version remains 17; no table, trigger or claim format changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No daemon API, client, wire, authority or admission contract change. Query results retain the existing semantics. Watch ownership, observer union across local and remote subscriptions, stopped-seat watches and final deadline wake semantics are retained.

downtime.detail: The ordinary binary swap restarts the service. Building the two indexes at first open reads existing claim history and adds startup work; fleet-sized startup duration has not been measured.

manual.detail: Existing installations create the indexes automatically on open; no manual migration or identity change is required.

recovery.detail: Older schema-17 binaries can open stores containing these additive indexes; swapping back leaves the indexes in place and restores the older lookup. No durable claims or projections are rewritten.
